Dear Asha,

Thank you for your generous gift of $125.00 to support our flood-response food kits. Your kindness helps Grace & Mercy Relief provide timely, practical support to families affected by flooding. We are grateful for your compassion and partnership in this important work.

Because of donors like you, hope and relief can reach people when they need it most. Thank you for standing with those facing hardship and helping meet urgent needs with care and dignity.

With sincere appreciation,
Grace & Mercy Relief

Dear Daniel,

Thank you for your generous $80.00 gift to Grace & Mercy Relief in support of clean-water distribution. Your kindness helps provide safe, reliable water to people facing urgent need, and we are deeply grateful for your compassion and partnership.

Because of supporters like you, our relief work can continue bringing practical help and hope to communities that need it most.

With sincere appreciation,
Grace & Mercy Relief

Dear Mira,

Thank you for your generous gift of $250.00 to Grace & Mercy Relief in support of temporary family shelter. Your kindness helps provide a safe, stable place for families during a difficult season, offering comfort and hope when it is needed most.

We are deeply grateful for your compassion and partnership in this important work. Your generosity makes a meaningful difference in the lives of those we serve.

With sincere appreciation,

Grace & Mercy Relief
